# OCR table corpus

`mixed-tables.png` is a synthetic DocWen-owned 1000 × 1200 raster fixture (SHA-256 `148b062b33fba374f72b67bf501e76931f0afc82d313f81961f582e846588b78`). It contains one ruled table, one borderless table, a heading, inter-table prose and a footnote. Each table has three rows and three columns. This is a deterministic packaged-model smoke oracle, not an accuracy benchmark or a substitute for real user samples. The fixture is stored as pixels so CI does not depend on a system font or an image-generation service.
